title: SM Current Controller
text: Discrete-time synchronous machine current PI controller, 6 inputs, 1 output, {Axis prioritization} sets Axis prioritization for voltage limiter; {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Discretization sample time} sets the block discretization sample time, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero-cancellation, {Enable pre-control voltage} sets the pre-control voltage, {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d-axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d-axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d-axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q-axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q-axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q-axis anti-windup gain, {Field current proportional gain}, {Field current integral gain} and {Field current anti-windup gain}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Block discretization sample time 0.001 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: Axis prioritization for voltage limiter q-axis (default) | d-axis | d-q equivalence

params.name: Field current proportional gain
params.values: Field current proportional gain 9 (default) | positive number

params.name: Field current integral gain
params.values: Field current integral gain 350 (default) | positive number

params.name: Field current anti-windup gain
params.values: Field current anti-windup gain 1 (default) | positive number
